g.title: crate Contracts and native import and export helpers for GPU texture sharing.
crate::common Adapter identities, contract mismatches and shared graphics API errors.
crate::d3d12 A shared pool on the engine's own Direct3D 12 device: textures, fences.
crate::d3d12::adapter Finds the DXGI adapter of a GpuAdapter by its LUID.
crate::d3d12::pool The engine's Direct3D 12 export pool: shared textures, fences, hand-off.
crate::d3d12::raw The Direct3D 12 helpers the pool and the read back share: barrier, wait.
crate::d3d12::read_back Reads an engine's Direct3D 12 texture back to the CPU as straight RGBA8.
crate::d3d12_contract Direct3D 12 flags, hand-off state and transitions of shared textures.
crate::device Opens the devices that import and export shared textures.
crate::import Imports an external engine's GPU textures and fences into wgpu.
crate::import::dx12 Direct3D 12 imports of shared resources and fences onto wgpu's queue.
crate::import::idle The longest an import waits for the device's queue to finish.
crate::import::pool Import: an engine's shared texture pool and its fences, opened on wgpu.
crate::import::vulkan Vulkan devices that import shared images and timeline semaphores.
crate::pool Export pool configuration, frame values and bounded slot bookkeeping.
crate::vulkan A shared pool on the engine's own ash device: images, semaphores, barriers.
crate::vulkan::physical_device Finds a GpuAdapter's Vulkan physical device and checks it can export.
crate::vulkan::pool The engine's Vulkan export pool: shared images, semaphores, barriers.
crate::vulkan::raw The export pool and read-back view of shared Vulkan helpers.
crate::vulkan::read_back Reads an engine's Vulkan image back to the CPU as straight RGBA8.
crate::vulkan_contract Vulkan version, extensions, layouts and usage of shared textures.
crate::vulkan_raw Shared Vulkan barriers, memory selection and timeline construction.
crate::wgpu A render engine's side of GPU texture sharing on Kivact's wgpu (29.0.4).
crate::wgpu::d3d12 The Direct3D 12 half of the wgpu helpers: device, wrapped textures, hand-off.
crate::wgpu::device Opens a wgpu device on the adapter a window names, able to share textures.
crate::wgpu::pool The engine's wgpu pool: shared textures, their format, usage and hand-off.
crate::wgpu::read_back Reads a wgpu texture back to the CPU as straight RGBA8, with wgpu alone.
crate::wgpu::vulkan The Vulkan half of the wgpu helpers: device, wrapped images, hand-off.
crate::wgpu_device Opens wgpu Vulkan devices with the shared-texture extensions.
